leadText: (Japanese: マッチャシティ Matcha City) is an -exclusive location in Kanto. Located between the and Cinnabar Island, it is the setting of the banned episode EP038. Dr. Akihabara's laboratory is located in this city. This city was the site of the showdown between and in the Pokémon Center's computer, although Nurse Joy thought it was merely Team Rocket's computer virus that caused the ruckus.
